title: Collection curator
idea: Collection curator: A chosen collection spine anchors meaningful item grouping, selection and a detail preview.
audience: People who need to curate collection within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Items need deliberate grouping and revisiting.
avoidWhen: The collection has no meaningful attributes beyond thumbnails.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic collection layout through its curate collection priority and explicit commitment contract: Persist only intended collection changes and provide undo for reversible removal.
navigation: Collection curator keeps the current curate collection context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A chosen collection spine anchors meaningful item grouping, selection and a detail preview.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to curate collection; items need deliberate grouping and revisiting.
composition.priority: Persist only intended collection changes and provide undo for reversible removal.

imagery.role: Support the actual curate collection context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Switch to a readable item list and expose selection mode explicitly.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the collection curator structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no curate collection content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Persist only intended collection changes and provide undo for reversible removal.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized curate collection content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Persist only intended collection changes and provide undo for reversible removal.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active curate collection context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
